    12 Aug 2003 I've modify CyaCE loader. Now you can load & run any images from network via ActiveSync. You need SynCE tools such as synce-libsynce,-librapi2,-dccm,-serial. First build and install libsynce, then librapi2, dccm and serial. Under user run dccm program. After attaching of Casio BE-300, run synce-serial-config ttyUSB0 or ttySx. Then run synce-serial-start - it will run pppd. Now you can run ActiveSync on BE-300. There you can find source of modified CyaCE loader and binary file with source of server-side program.

    NOTE:I didn't try new loader with serial cable.
